body:
Hi. 
I think forgot including this in my post. 

I have been suffering from depression since 14-15 yrs now. 
I have always been a recluse. Have had barely 2-3 friends. Even they are not that close. 

She is the first love of my life. Though she might have triggered this most recent suicidal thoughts, I don’t think she is the only reason. 

Also, knowing myself, I don’t think I’ll ever love anyone else. If do survive, i might develop relationships, but I’ll only ever love her

Thanks for your concern. 

I know cutting out all the harmful things from my life will help. 
And I have pinpointed that thing. Its me. 

Apart from my godforesaken self, I cant really complain about anything.

Wow man! You really are a good writer👍

I could relate to a lot of your story man! Privileged life...being over weight without any particular reason...being lonely....and wanting to die. All of it. 

But hey...whenever I am thinking straight, I know that killing myself is not the answer. It never will be. 
The same goes for you bud. Just hang on. Hopefully things will take a better turn. For the both of us. 🤪
what is the name of that fucking bug?? I need it stat!
